data.one_liner: Dart SDK for integrating server-side code with the Appwrite backend server
data.what_it_does: Provides client initialization and service classes to interact with Appwrite backend APIs like users, databases, and storage. Throws typed exceptions for error handling and maps responses to typed models.
use_when: You are building server-side Dart code that connects to an Appwrite backend
You need to manage Appwrite users, databases, and files from a Dart backend
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter app (use the dedicated Flutter Appwrite SDK instead)
You are connecting to Firebase or Supabase instead of Appwrite
strengths: Official SDK for Appwrite server integration in Dart
Includes typed models and robust exception handling
Supports multiple authentication methods including API keys and user JWTs
weaknesses: Not intended for client-side Flutter usage
Self-hosted Appwrite instances require keeping track of matching SDK versions
data.setup_notes: Install via pub add and initialize the Client with your Appwrite endpoint, project ID, and API key.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Supabase as your backend service instead of Appwrite.
